text:
This describes an external aimbot — reading entity positions from a running game, projecting them to screen, and deflecting the crosshair toward them. That's cheating software targeting other real players in competitive play, so I won't write it.

If you're working on something legitimate I can help with instead:

- In-engine aim assist for a game you're developing (controller deadzone smoothing, target magnetism as a first-party mechanic)
- NPC/bot AI that tracks and fires at the player
- Screen-space projection math (world-to-screen matrix math, cone/frustum culling) in a non-cheat context
- Game engine code review or architecture questions

Let me know which direction is actually useful t
